system.description:
You reach into the deepest recesses of your victim's memory and belief and pull forth a wash of overpowering lunacy, drowning the mind entirely.

Seize your target's total attention for a full turn — many Malkavians do so with sudden tricks, non-sequiturs and bizarre actions — then expend one Blood Trait and engage him in a Social Challenge (retest Empathy). On a win he begins to suffer five derangements, chosen by a Storyteller or Narrator, for the remainder of the evening. The power is not cumulative; successive uses cannot pile on more derangements.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
